options.name: netflow_server
options.description: IP address or hostname of the NetFlow collector. Required for C(state=present) and C(state=updated).

options.name: netflow_server_port
options.description: UDP port number for the NetFlow collector. Required for C(state=present) and C(state=updated).

options.name: server_name
options.description: Unique identifier for the NetFlow server configuration. Required for all states except C(query) when fetching all servers.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) - Add a new NetFlow server configuration. Fails if server_name already exists. C(updated) - Modify an existing NetFlow server configuration. Fails if server_name does not exist. C(absent) - Remove a NetFlow server configuration. C(query) - Retrieve NetFlow server configuration(s).
